newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan to buy up to 750,000 bbls of Dec reformate.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to buy up to 750,000 bbls of Dec reformate.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) is expected to buy up to 750,000 barrels of 95-octane reformate in three cargoes in its tender for December delivery at around $25.00 a barrel, sources said on Wednesday.
"We will definitely buy one leaded cargo and maybe one to two cargoes of unleaded reformate," an official said, expecting the awards to be approved later on Wednesday evening.

In its tender which closed November 5 and valid until November 7, CPC sought 250,000 barrels of unleaded reformate for delivery in the second half of December and 250,000 barrels of leaded reformate for December 6-20 delivery, on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keelung or Taichung.
Last month, CPC cancelled its last requirement for leaded reformate, for December 1-15, delivery due to high international prices and low domestic demand.
In its previously awarded tender, CPC bought two 250,000-barrel cargoes of unleaded reformate for November 21-30 and December 1-15 deliveries around $25.90 per barrel on a c-and-f basis.
